title: A lane-lint verdict is recorded with its head, and `merge --reviewed` shows it
why: Lane notes-fix-page ([ended:lane:-notes-fix-page]), 04:46 CST Nov 9: it handed #2034 to the coordinator as lint-passed because the review lane said so in a message; the lint had timed out (UNKNOWN, ci-job did not finish in 1200 s). A hand-off that rests on a message, not a recorded verdict, can send an unlinted PR into a batch.
note: Fix proposed by the lane: `merge --lane-lint` records its verdict and head (a PR comment or a record field), and `merge --reviewed` prints it beside the record state. Related: step lane-lint-before-push. Filed 04:47 CST Nov 9. Coordinator (12:59 CST Nov 9), from lane time-from-one-helper (#2258): folded candidate record-needs-head-lint. `merge --review-record` refuses unless a lane-lint PASS is logged for that exact head. Incident: #2153 was handed with a lint from an older head.
